independent_unit: one E011 STATIC_READY upstream provider anchor for BASIC/FULL; one E011 STATIC_READY primary carrier for CERTIFY; multiple variants from one provider group are correlated cross-source evidence
parser_contract: Consume E011-v0.3.0 only when RUN_SUMMARY.json has schema E011-SKLSA-STATIC-READY-ATLAS-1, e011_version=0.3.0, execution_gate=PASS, operational_error_count=0 and e010_release_version=0.3.1; SEED_CONTRACT_SCHEMA.json must be E011-STATIC-SEED-CONTRACT-1 with atlas_version=0.3.0 and dynamics_ready=false. BASIC/FULL consume STATIC_READY_PROVIDER_ANCHORS.jsonl; CERTIFY consumes STATIC_READY_PRIMARY_SEEDS.jsonl. Every admitted row must be static_ready=true, evidence_class=UPSTREAM_INDEPENDENT, seed_role=PRIMARY_REFERENCE and have a resolvable source_locator. Supported representations are xyz, vect and gilbert_ab_record. Raw source SHA-256 is verified exactly. Gilbert geometry is reconstructed from the pinned catalogue record identified by topology_id/reference_id; sampled floating-point geometry hashes are not used as a cross-platform hard gate.
translator_contract: Coordinates remain in source units during blind scoring. E011 topology_id, carrier_id, source_family, provider_group, source paths and source hashes are HMAC-opaque in public outputs and retained only in the private reveal map. No SST length, density, circulation, particle identity, or mass calibration enters blind gates.

replication_policy.same_provider_multiple_carriers: FULL uses E011 deterministic provider anchors; CERTIFY exposes all primary same-provider variants and disagreement becomes INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY

mode_population.BASIC: up to 8 deterministic E011 provider anchors, topology/provider round-robin
mode_population.CERTIFY: all E011 primary STATIC_READY upstream carriers
